issues.quote: with revenue of $394.3 billion against $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022, a decline of 2.8%
issues.problem: Fiscal 2023 revenue was about $383.3 billion, not $394.3 billion ($394.3 billion is the fiscal 2022 figure). Listing the same number for both years contradicts the stated 2.8% decline.

data.summary: Fiscal 2023 revenue is misstated: it shows the fiscal 2022 figure of $394.3 billion instead of about $383.3 billion. Gross profit, margins, operating income, net income, EPS and R&D all match Apple's reported results.
